title: Production needs a usable workbench and bill
applies_when: A colony objective requires repeated production.
approach: Inspect existing workbenches and bills before requesting another facility.
Choose a native recipe supported by the actual workbench, then configure its count or target and ingredient filters.
Consider nearby selective storage where it reduces travel; avoid assuming every workbench needs a separate room.
verify: Native recipe availability, ingredients, fuel/power where relevant, pawn skill and bill restrictions.
Produced items and native bill progress rather than only bill creation.
reconsider: The existing facility is adequate, inputs are unavailable, or another bottleneck dominates.
